text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Taiki Shuttle, usually so 
cheerful, uncharacteristically wore a 
rather gloomy expression.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... My heart feels prickly... Little 
sisters, are you being a bit cold...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... The other day, my little sisters 
sent me some sweets, you see.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But when I asked her what she wanted in 
return earlier, she went into full cool 
mode with an 'I'm fine, whatever'... In 
that totally monotone voice...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~, she was laughing so much when I 
called her the other day... What 
happened!?
choice_data_list:
What kind of conversation was it back 
then?
What were you talking about back then?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... We were reporting on each other's 
status updates, having a blast! It was a 
super happy time, yes?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —Oh! But, at the very end...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki's Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
"When can you come home, Big Sis?" "We 
were thinking it'd be nice for the three 
of us to bake sweets together sometime."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, sorry! I'm busy right now, so I 
might not be able to come right away."

text_block_list.name: Taiki's Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
"I see... Well, it can't be helped, 
right?" "Yeah. Big sis is doing her best, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I feel like her voice 
dropped a whole tone!
choice_data_list: Maybe they felt a little lonely.
Maybe they felt a little lonely.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, nooooooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...B-But! I feel the exact same way! I 
miss my sisters!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Okay! In that case, comfort! I shall 
convey my lonely feelings to those girls!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Since we made them feel uneasy, let's show 
them with a huge tangible result! 
Trainer-san, please help me out!
choice_data_list: Yeah, if it's within my power!
Yeah, if there's anything I can do!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, camera ready? Three, two, one—...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"—Heeey, my cute little sisters! How are 
you all doing?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I'm going to share my true 
feelings with you all in a video! Make 
sure you watch closely, okay!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Ta-da! Look at this candy patch shining 
on my apron! Do you remember it?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"—Right! The three of us made it together! 
Mama taught us how, and we went 
stitch-by-stitch, squeezing tight and 
having so much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Those fun memories are my treasure! 
That's why I sewed them on like this♪"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Wearing this makes my heart all warm! I 
can kind of feel all of you with me!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Look, look! It's my personal booster of 
energy!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"A photo the three of us took before 
coming to Japan! Whenever I greet this 
before running, it gives me so much 
power!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"‘Sweeties, watch me run!’ Keep your eyes 
on me! Watch my boosted stride—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "—Look, look! Yaaaahooooooo!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle spoke candidly about how she 
feels about her younger sisters while 
living in Japan. And at the end of the 
video—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"—Not a single day goes by without me 
thinking about you all!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"‘So when I get back, I'm gonna give you a 
hug! At full power! A super biiiiiig 
squeeze!!’"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry about today, okay? Please make do 
with an air hug through the video screen!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"And you all too! Bottling up sad feelings 
is poison! If you're feeling lonely, make 
sure you speak up, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, see you later! 
—*Squeeeeeze*!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Taiki Shuttle's video full of love 
was delivered to her younger sisters.

text_block_list.name: Taiki's Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: “—Big sis...”

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —! A message, from those girls...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "We feel the same way"... Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Since we can't see each other, let's talk 
more! Could you let Big Sis know when 
you're free?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Trainer! Sharing some happiness, for 
you!
choice_data_list: Wow, that smells delicious, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! These are my family's traditional, 
delicious muffins!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I was cooking while talking on the 
smartphone with the little sisters! We 
promised to make mille-feuille next time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Please EN-JOY these sweets packed with the 
Sisters' delight!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Got a reply from the little sisters! They 
said, "We miss you too!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! They even told me that they want to 
visit Japan sometime!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So, movie part 2! I'll introduce some hot 
spots in Japan! Let's start filming right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, excuse me! Is it okay if I take a 
video of you?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The other day, I had a fun chat with 
my little sisters! And then, both of them 
said they wanna get to know you even 
better!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So, I'd like to introduce you! --To my 
wonderful Trainer, whom I'm so proud of!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Is there a good handicraft shop 
around here, YES?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I made a promise with the little sisters! 
I'll make patches and give them as 
presents like old times! I'll definitely 
make something great!
choice_data_list:
Sounds good! I'll show you around on our 
next day off!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks very much! Hehe, I can't wait, 
desu!
